items.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
items.teaser: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

items.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
items.teaser: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

items.title: XRP’s shrinking exchange supply may be telling investors the wrong story

items.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi after platform halts operations
items.teaser: AG Derek Brown's office filed a motion Monday to drop the charges without prejudice, meaning it can refile if Kalshi returns.

items.title: Europol operation involving Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis traces more than $28.5 million in crypto behind illegal streaming services
items.teaser: Europol traced more than €26 million ($28.5 million) in crypto transactions during an investigation into illegal IPTV services.

items.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
items.teaser: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

items.title: XRP Ledger DEX volume hits 4.51 million XRP a day in Q3 as big traders take over: Evernorth
items.teaser: XRP Ledger DEX order-book volume averaged 4.51M XRP a day in Q3, Evernorth says, as top accounts drove 65% of trading and RLUSD rose 74%.

items.title: Ledn brings US business onshore with account to hold, swap and borrow against bitcoin
items.teaser: Ledn's new U.S. custody account lets customers hold bitcoin, gold, stablecoins and dollars, swap with no trading fees and borrow against bitcoin without selling.

items.title: BTCS sells more than half its ether to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt
items.teaser: The firm's DeFi business, Imperium, temporarily pulled out of liquidity pools after generating $3.5 million in Q3 revenue.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as rally on Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return fades
items.teaser: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1% after the index surged on Monday, while the Dollar Index held above 104, its highest level since March 2025.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team, calls AI a ‘more urgent risk’ than quantum
items.teaser: The Ethereum Foundation is expanding its security resources as advances in AI raise new concerns about cryptography and software security.
